meta.title: deep-research-os — research that survives scrutiny
meta.description: An open-source research operating system for AI agents. Every claim traces to a verbatim quote, every source to a SHA-256 snapshot, every report to hard gates. MIT, zero API keys.
meta.og_description: Evidence ledger, citation verification, contradiction protocol, requirement coverage and bilingual reports. Open source, MIT, no API keys required.

hero.eyebrow: Agent skill · MIT · zero API keys
hero.lede: A self-improving research operating system for AI agents. Every claim traces to a verbatim quote, every source to a SHA-256 snapshot, every report to hard gates.

rows.claim: Staged gates beat single-shot approval when demand is uncertain.
RICE ranks bets; it does not price the option to wait.
Regulatory ambiguity raises the value of deferral.
BNPL trust shocks change channel mix, not gate order.

features.title: Built to be audited, not trusted.
features.desc: The pipeline makes the quiet work visible: search logs, evidence quotes, credibility bands, contradictions, and the gaps you would rather hide.

items.title: Evidence ledger
items.desc: Every claim carries a verbatim quote and a locator; every source carries a SHA-256 snapshot of what was actually read.

items.title: Citation verification
items.desc: DOI and citation resolution, online and offline. Fabricated references and number drift never make it into the report.

items.title: Contradiction protocol
items.desc: Conflicts are recorded, graded and adjudicated, with severity and resolution kept on the record.

items.title: Rigor gates
items.desc: Requirements, full-text evidence depth, numeric provenance and reproducible model cards are hard gates; every waiver lands in Limitations.

items.title: PRISMA-lite search log
items.desc: Every query is journaled with an ID, engine, hit count and screening outcome. Reproducible by default.

items.title: Bilingual reports
items.desc: Persian and English reports with real RTL, light and dark themes, embedded fonts, and clean A4 print output.

pipeline.title: Ten phases. Every exit is a gate.
pipeline.desc: Each phase produces artifacts the next phase can check. Nothing advances on vibes.

phases.name: Intake
phases.desc: Question, profile, deliverable type and explicit requirements.

phases.name: Landscape
phases.desc: Angles, actors and a source map before any query runs.

phases.name: Plan
phases.desc: Initial queries, collection matrix and stop rules.

phases.name: Collect
phases.desc: Route queries to free public APIs; snapshot every source.

phases.name: Extract
phases.desc: Verbatim quotes with locators, never paraphrase as evidence.

phases.name: Assess
phases.desc: Credibility bands, source tiers and screening reasons.

phases.name: Verify
phases.desc: Citations, numbers, modality, corroboration and staleness.

phases.name: Report
phases.desc: Markdown and self-contained HTML; hard report gates.

phases.name: Retrospect
phases.desc: What worked, what failed, and reversible learning proposals.

preview.title: The report is the proof.
preview.desc: A real validation run on fintech portfolio decisions: all 24 prompt requirements mapped, 12 logged searches, 43 screened sources, 11 key studies and 15 findings — in Persian, APA 7, with a claim-and-evidence appendix.
preview.title_short: Stage-gated fintech portfolio decisions under uncertainty
preview.excerpt: The model separates ranking from pricing: RICE orders the bets, staged gates decide when capital is released, and real options price the value of waiting.

validation.title: Numbers from a real run.
validation.desc: Not a demo dataset. The validation run researched a live decision problem end to end: 52 claims, 60 evidence quotes, 43 sources, 12 logged searches — and every requirement mapped.
evals: Planted contradiction is found and adjudicated
Echo chamber raises a corroboration gap
validation.note: Run with RESEARCH_OS_OFFLINE=1. No network, no keys, deterministic.

install.title: Sixty seconds to a governed run.
install.desc: Python 3.11+. No API keys. The installer creates a venv, links the skill into your agent platform and verifies the environment.

steps.title: Start a run
steps.cmd: python scripts/research_ctl.py init "Your research question" --profile deep --dir ~/Research/your-topic

install.platforms: Claude Code · OpenCode · Codex · Cursor · generic

items.a: No. Eighteen free public search APIs, web fetch and PDF extraction work without keys; CORE adds an optional key. Optional keys only add capacity; the pipeline is designed to run keyless.
Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex, Cursor and any generic skill directory. The installer auto-detects platforms; SKILL.md carries the workflow.
A brief and plan, a search journal, source snapshots, an evidence ledger, a verification report, findings, report.md, a self-contained report.html and a retrospective.

items.q: Is the Persian output real RTL?
items.a: Yes. Reports are rendered in English or Persian (auto-detected or --lang fa), with RTL layout, embedded Vazirmatn, translated labels and APA 7 references.

items.q: What do the hard gates check?
items.a: IDs resolve, every fact line is cited, numbers and their source dates match, no placeholders, open contradictions stay visible, weak claims are labeled, requirements are covered, bibliography fields are complete, and computational claims ship a reproducible model check.

footer.tagline: An evidence-first research operating system for AI agents.
footer.author: Built by Nariman Khaleghi
footer.rights: Open source. No telemetry. Your research stays in your folder.
